title: Robo-Greeno Data A: Hexapod Kinematics, Gait Generation, and RL Locomotion for Agricultural Spider Robots
description: Open-source workspace and an intuitive Physical AI tutorial for the Data A track of the KamaTech Robo-Greeno project: a swarm of six-legged spider robots for agricultural settings. Covers hexapod kinematics, tripod/wave/ripple gait generation, IMU stabilization, MuJoCo physics simulation, and reinforcement-learning locomotion, targeting ESP32 + Raspberry Pi class hardware. Includes a four-chapter beginner tutorial on LLMs vs embodied AI, leg design in nature, MuJoCo, and reinforcement learning.
